pop.description: Mainstream pop music balances catchy melodies with high production quality. It typically features clear vocal hooks and commercial appeal.

lofi.description: Lo-fi hip hop emphasizes relaxed tempos, soft textures, and atmospheric beats. It is widely used for studying, focus sessions, and winding down.

rock.description: Rock spans a broad spectrum from classic guitar-driven tracks to heavy metal. Core traits include electric guitars, strong rhythms, and often intense or rebellious themes.

ambient.description: Ambient music prioritizes texture, atmosphere, and slow evolution over traditional melody and rhythm. It is designed for background listening or deep relaxation.

jazz.description: Jazz features improvisation, complex harmonics, and swing rhythms. It ranges from energetic bebop to relaxed cool jazz, often evoking warmth and sophistication.

synthwave.description: Synthwave draws from 1980s electronic music, film scores, and video game soundtracks. Heavy synthesizer use creates moody, nostalgic tones.

edm.description: Electronic dance music is built for high-energy environments. It features powerful drops, repetitive build-ups, and synthesized textures optimized for dancing.

folk.description: Folk music emphasizes acoustic instruments, storytelling lyrics, and authenticity rooted in tradition. It often carries nostalgic or introspective tones.

r&b.description: R&B blends soul, funk, and pop into smooth, groove-oriented tracks. It often features rich vocals and themes of love, confidence, and emotion.

metal.description: Metal is defined by heavy distorted guitars, aggressive rhythms, and high intensity. It ranges from melodic to extreme sub-genres but always prioritizes power.

country.description: Country music blends storytelling with acoustic and electric instruments, often evoking rural life, nostalgia, and emotional honesty.

disco.description: Disco is built for the dancefloor — high energy and euphoric, with lush orchestration and a strong four-on-the-floor beat.

hip hop.description: Hip hop centers on rhythmic vocals over beats, with emphasis on lyrics, culture, and flow. It spans from laid-back to high-energy depending on subgenre.

classical.description: Classical music encompasses a vast tradition of orchestral, chamber, and solo compositions. It rewards attentive listening and conveys a wide emotional range from serene to dramatic.

indie pop.description: Indie pop blends the catchiness of mainstream pop with the creativity of the indie scene, featuring upbeat melodies and often introspective lyrics.

happy.description: Upbeat, bright, and feel-good. Look for high valence and moderate-to-high energy.

chill.description: Relaxed and easygoing, not mentally demanding. Low energy with a comfortable, pleasant tone.

intense.description: High energy and emotionally charged. Often drives focus, adrenaline, or strong feeling.

focused.description: Minimal distraction, steady rhythm, and low vocal density. Helps maintain concentration.

moody.description: Emotionally complex and atmospheric. Can feel introspective, melancholic, or mysterious.

romantic.description: Warm, intimate, and emotionally expressive. Often smooth-sounding with moderate energy.

excited.description: High energy and enthusiasm, often with fast tempo and euphoric feel.

nostalgic.description: Evokes a sense of past memories, often bittersweet or warm. Moderate energy and mid valence.

peaceful.description: Calm, serene, and undisturbed. Very low energy with high or neutral valence.

aggressive.description: Forceful and confrontational. Maximum energy with low to mid valence.

joyful.description: Pure happiness expressed through music — celebratory and full of life.

confident.description: Assured, bold, and purposeful. Often features strong rhythms and direct energy.

relaxed.description: Easy and unhurried, with a laid-back groove. Lower energy, warm tone.

calm.description: Quiet and composed, without tension. Often acoustic and slow.

introspective.description: Thoughtful and inward-looking. Often slower and less danceable, with richer lyrical content.

audio_features.energy: Measures overall intensity from 0.0 (silent/calm) to 1.0 (extremely loud and fast). High energy suits workouts; low energy suits studying or sleep.
audio_features.danceability: How suitable a track is for dancing based on tempo, rhythm stability, and beat strength. High values mean the beat is easy to move to.
audio_features.valence: The musical positivity of a track from 0.0 (sad, dark) to 1.0 (happy, euphoric). High valence brightens mood; low valence feels more somber.
audio_features.acousticness: Confidence that a track is acoustic rather than electronically produced. High values indicate guitar, piano, or orchestral pieces without heavy processing.
audio_features.instrumentalness: Predicts whether a track has no vocals. Values above 0.5 suggest primarily instrumental music; above 0.8 almost certainly instrumental.
audio_features.tempo_bpm: Beats per minute — the pace of the music. Below 80 BPM feels slow and relaxed; above 140 BPM feels fast and intense.
audio_features.liveliness: Detects presence of a live audience. High values suggest a concert recording rather than a studio track.
audio_features.lyric_density: How word-heavy the vocals are. High values mean lots of lyrics (rap, storytelling); low values mean sparse or absent vocals.
